definitions.gloss: unchanged; as always; as before; without change
definitions.explanation: Remaining the same as before; continuing in the same state without alteration. Often used to express that something persists over time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{相変|あいか}わらず→相変わらず：01671_aikawarazu⟧⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧だ⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.notes: The compound {相変|あいか}わらず is the most common form in everyday speech.

examples.japanese: {十年|じゅうねん}⟦{経|た}って→経つ：09892_tatsu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{変|か}わらず⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧だ。
examples.english: Even after ten years, that town is quiet, just as it was before.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{変|か}わらず、⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦ジョギング→ジョギング：04738_jogingu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Just as in the past, I continue jogging every morning.

notes:
{変|か}わらず is the negative continuative form (ず form) of ⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧ (to change), functioning as an adverb meaning "without changing." It expresses constancy or persistence of a state.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{相変|あいか}わらず→相変わらず：01671_aikawarazu⟧: as always; as usual — the most frequently used form, often with a nuance of mild exasperation or familiarity
- ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{変|か}わらず: same as in the old days
- ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{変|か}わらず: still the same now

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {変|か}わらず⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧: as healthy as always
- ⟦{変|か}わらぬ→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧⟦{友情|ゆうじょう}→友情：03648_yuujou⟧: unchanging friendship
- ⟦{変|か}わらない→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧: an unchanging smile

COMMON PATTERNS:
The ず form is a classical negative form that survives in modern Japanese as an adverbial. The attributive form is ⟦{変|か}わらぬ→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧ (literary) or ⟦{変|か}わらない→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧ (modern): ⟦{変|か}わらぬ→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧⟦{愛|あい}→愛：02370_ai⟧ (unchanging love).
